original_requirement: TODO23: second-pass import/module call resolution for TypeScript, Python, Rust, Go and Java using the existing two-pass architecture. The first four languages are delivered; Java is the one active item. The original broader backlog remains open.
observed_missing_behavior: Java method_invocation extraction captures only the method name. It does not retain receiver/type qualification, file-local import identity or package-aware target evidence; generic name/FQN lookup cannot reliably distinguish same-name methods in imported classes.
finite_acceptance: Resolve same-package and fully qualified class calls, single-type and on-demand imports, and single/static-on-demand imported bare methods from indexed Java declarations. Preserve canonical nested type identity and file-local import scope; never guess by terminal method name.

Resolve ordinary calls through explicitly declared local/parameter/field receiver types and same-class bare/this calls to source declarations. Respect lexical shadowing and access/static distinctions. Distinguish arity and retain ambiguous overloads, unsupported type inference/inheritance/dynamic dispatch, inaccessible declarations, unindexed dependencies and unsupported module semantics as explicit unresolved evidence rather than fabricated certainty.

Publish bounded call/import/target source evidence through the existing public references surface. Independent authored cases assert exact declaration identity and negative cases under native/no-vector builds; preserve prior language integration checks.

Retain Java facts in source publication so import/package/declaration edits rebind unchanged callers, stale targets retract and deletion/restoration recovers the right links. Old-index graph repair must upgrade retained source facts and preserve source/search/vector storage, recovered chunks and generation without embedding work where the source set is unchanged.

Verify the authored behavior through actual candidate and installed MCP, verify normal installed daemon identity, record temporary-resource cleanup, commit and push only origin/master. Parent TODO23 and remaining original requirements are evaluated honestly after Java delivery, not closed merely because tests pass.
next_action: Implement retained Java package/import/typed-receiver facts and second-pass resolution against the recorded finite acceptance. Do not rerun baseline or reopen delivered Go.
constraints: One implementation item. No CodeMap/Blast changes, compiler/build-system infrastructure, dependency downloads, runtime-dispatch or full compiler claims. Preserve other unfinished original findings.
